# Somehow I Manage

> A people-first task manager for managers. Every task, note and 1:1 lives with the person it is about, and the People Map shows the whole team at a glance.

Somehow I Manage is a free web app at https://somehowimanage.app/ made by Sergii Kryvoblotskyi, a manager who kept his team in notes titled with people's names and turned that habit into a tool. It is installable (PWA), works offline, and syncs through the user's own Google or Microsoft account; passkeys can be added afterwards. Data lives on the device and in a private database per account (Supabase); there are no ads, no trackers, no third-party analytics and no data sales (the only measurement is a first-party count of visits by day), and everything can be exported or deleted by the user.

## What it does

- People Map: each person is a hub on a canvas with their tasks and notes around them; drag a card onto someone else to hand it over; people out of view stay pinned at the edge.
- 1:1 mode: start a 1:1 from a person's page; the agenda is their open items; tick what got done, mark what was discussed, capture new items; ending the meeting records it and the next one shows what happened since.
- Person page: tasks, notes and completed work for one person, with a line to type the next thing.
- Projects: tag any task or note with a project; the tag shows on cards and rows, and the Projects panel on the map counts what hangs on each project and spotlights one across people on click.
- Quick capture: ⌘K from anywhere to jump to a person, find a task, or type "Name: task" to add one.
- Offline-first, syncing, export to Markdown, JSON backup and restore.

## For AI agents (MCP)

Somehow I Manage has a Model Context Protocol server. Any MCP client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code) connects to https://mvpbxmlczninyqsyjhqh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp ; the user signs in with their own account and approves the client once (OAuth 2.1 through Supabase Auth). Tools: list_people, get_person, prepare_one_on_one, whats_due, search, add_task, add_note, add_person, update_item, complete_task, move_item, delete_item, list_projects, create_project. The server acts as the user under the same access rules as the app; details at https://somehowimanage.app/mcp/.
